method: Direct visual inspection of actual preview2 neutral-front, five Idle render PNGs, and preserved preview-attempt1 idle-back. No model-source edits, Blender/Unreal execution or generated replacement image by reviewer.
scope: Source preview after donor binding and regional material tone changes; not fresh FBX or Unreal acceptance.

prior_candidate.observed_defect: Thin diagonal cape/arm shards project well beyond both upper arms; accordion/triangular folds around the cape's lateral back.

ledger.requirement: Preserve donor neutral silhouette and reference identity
ledger.observation: The T-pose retains donor face/hair, hood/cape silhouette, blouse, embroidered layered coat, pants, boots, bag and potions. No large arm spikes appear in this neutral pose. This does not establish motion acceptance.

ledger.requirement: Idle arms-down sleeves/bracers retain fitted non-exploding surfaces
ledger.observation: Both upper sleeves produce broad white shards pointing diagonally up/out. Both brown bracers are stretched into large triangular wings pointing toward the upper-arm/shoulder region. Hands remain at the ends of the lowered arms, while only part of the garment is stretched. This is a severe visible deformation failure and a delivery blocker.
ledger.source_cause_status: Not directly inspected. The contrast between clean T-pose and failed arms-down indicates a skin/pose-related issue. Suspect an incorrect or discontinuous weight mask on some sleeve/bracer vertices, including garment vertices left on torso/cape influence, but do not treat this hypothesis as established.
ledger.repair: Inspect affected source vertex weights and bone transforms at the stated regions. Rebind/resmooth only the failed semantic regions while preserving donor UV/forms. Recheck identical neutral and all three Idle views, then elbow/reach/twist poses on both sides.

ledger.requirement: Cape main rear body avoids attempt1 accordion/shards
ledger.observation: The broad central rear cape and hood now retain a smoother continuous curved silhouette. The earlier folded small lateral back triangles are much reduced. This localized improvement does not close P2-02; the adjacent sleeve/bracer deformation is larger and still fails.
ledger.limit: Front cape wing folds remain mechanically compressed around the shoulders in the arms-down pose. Dynamic or alternate pose acceptance is not established.

ledger.requirement: Face/hair reference identity improves without severe face deformation
ledger.observation: Face shape, eye expression, shaped ear/nose/cheek, side braid and hair-lock silhouette are far closer to the supplied PNG than procedural v2. No large face, neck or eye loss/collapse is observed in these views.
ledger.limit: Eyes/lips remain texture dependent and the skin/eye detail is soft at this closeup. This is not a facial-rig or moving-eyelid pass.

ledger.requirement: Hair palette resembles the chestnut reference without bright painted crown wash
ledger.observation: The darker front/left locks and warm skin are improved compared with the first pale donor renders. A broad near-white patch and pale stripe remain across the crown and viewer-right hair; the profile retains conspicuously light streaks. The reference uses finer chestnut variation, rather than this broad white-looking crown.
ledger.repair: After arm repair, diagnose whether these bright regions are fixed atlas highlights, normal/specular response, or unclassified color-mask regions. Use the neutral albedo/unchanged lighting comparison; adjust only confirmed hair highlight regions without losing skin or ivory cloth.

ledger.requirement: Confirmed crown local gap is no longer visibly black in repaired preview
ledger.observation: A small black wedge remains under the upper swept lock near the crown/part at approximately x=393..413,y=306..340 in the 900x1100 face image. A source inspector previously confirmed a crown boundary hole in this region. The new camera/framing differs from the original 800x900 camera; exact geometric correspondence must be checked, but the visible mark is not resolved in this preview.
ledger.repair: Check the repaired boundary loop and the nearby overlapping small hair component/patch at this location. Fill/rejoin only confirmed unwanted missing surface and preserve intended curl gaps. Reopen the same face closeup after the final source/export revision.

ledger.requirement: Lower body/accessories retain coherent Idle silhouette
ledger.observation: Torso, belt, satchel, potions, coat/apron, trousers and boots remain visibly coherent in these sampled stationary poses. No catastrophic pelvis, knee or ankle collapse is observed.
ledger.limit: No knee/hip pose, full Idle timeline, continuous gait or collision proof is supplied by this limited sample.

ledger.requirement: Fresh exported deformation and Unreal behavior remain valid
ledger.observation: These are source preview renders. Reviewer has not received fresh FBX, lower LOD, engine material/animation or tutorial runtime evidence for this revision.

positive_changes: Main back cape improved relative to attempt1
Darker warm front locks and skin improve palette
Lower body and equipment coherent in sampled Idle views
blocking_remaining_defects: Severe bilateral sleeve/bracer triangle stretching in arms-down Idle
Visible local black crown/part wedge persists
critical_next_evidence: Same six cameras from repaired durable source
Both elbow/reach poses and arms-down Idle
Fresh export materials/weights and actual Unreal validation
